symptom: ako/mxcli#2055: describe → exec of TestApp's WorkflowCommons.ManageTaskAssignments refused 'snippet …Snip_TaskAssignment_UserTask_Assignees requires parameter $Account'; with that refusal lifted, the rebuilt page failed mx check with CE1613 'System.User.FullName no longer exists' at two labels.
cause: (1) buildSnippetCallParams accepted an omitted snippet parameter only from the nearest data container (pb.entityContext); Mendix takes it from any enclosing one — here a System.User data view around a Data grid 2 of System.WorkflowUserTask, stored with no mapping, mx check 0 errors. (2) associationSourcePath printed a single hop as the bare association, dropping a stored DestinationEntity that specialises the association's end.
file: mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3_widgets.go (outerEntityContexts, contextSupplies), mdl/executor/widget_engine.go (Build pushes the outer context), mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_datasource.go (withSpecialisedDestination)
insight: Lifting a refusal can turn a loud failure into a silent broken write: after making the builder accept the call, run mx check on the result before calling it fixed — the refusal had been hiding a describe gap (#721 L5's specialised-destination class, single-hop case) that produced CE1613.
